features.name: Guided Start flow
features.does: Choose an outcome, select your ZIP and follow findings to next steps.
features.limit: No installation is needed for browser analysis.

features.name: ZIP inventory and platform clues
features.does: See inspected languages, files, manifests, runtimes and referenced services.
features.limit: Clues do not prove the whole deployed platform is present.

features.name: Plain-language findings
features.does: Read supported feature explanations with evidence and unknowns.
features.limit: The analyzer cannot tell you exactly everything an application does.

features.name: Source tracing
features.does: Follow selected Python and JavaScript/TypeScript routes, React props/callbacks, computed API targets and Supabase data references.
features.limit: Bounded static readers; dynamic paths and unsupported patterns can remain unresolved.

features.name: Binary clues
features.does: Inspect supported executable/container metadata, strings and target clues.
features.limit: Not full decompilation or reconstruction.

features.name: File alerts
features.does: Review green, yellow and red signals, selected ZIP integrity checks and suspicious patterns.
features.limit: Green is not a safety certificate; not antivirus or a complete vulnerability audit.

features.name: Workflow paths
features.does: Follow supported screen-to-callback-to-API-to-data candidate paths.
features.limit: Static connections do not establish permissions, runtime conditions or success.

features.name: Graphical feature map
features.does: Focus a feature, inspect nodes and edges and save the visible SVG.
features.limit: View capped at 120 nodes and 240 edges; omissions are disclosed.

features.name: Imports and dependencies
features.does: Explore candidate file/module and referenced-package relationships.
features.limit: Not a full runtime call graph; drawn import view shows first 100 unique edges.

features.name: Evidence and coverage
features.does: Search source locations and see inspected, unresolved and omitted material.
features.limit: Coverage describes this inspection; it is not test coverage.

features.name: Compare deliveries
features.does: Compare saved reports for file, finding and feature-map relationship changes.
features.limit: Analyzer-version changes can affect output; differences do not prove behavior changed.

features.name: Candidate change impact
features.does: Explore bounded upstream/downstream neighbors before maintenance.
features.limit: Potentially affected components need developer confirmation.

features.name: Setup and supporting-service clues
features.does: Collect runtime names, configuration names, migrations, scripts and operation questions.
features.limit: No live service connection, production permissions or cost verification.

features.name: Saved handover checklist
features.does: Assign owners, statuses and notes; restore a matching saved checklist.
features.limit: Reviewer status is a human claim; notes need a separate save.

features.name: Report exports
features.does: Save readable HTML, structured JSON, map SVG or one local handover ZIP with checklist and remaining questions.
features.limit: Pack limit 64 MiB. Notes and runtime evidence are opt-in. Original code ZIP and AI conversations are excluded.

features.name: AI-to-AI handover
features.does: Give a developer using another coding tool a report, evidence, gaps and the original authorized code package.
features.limit: Does not transfer chat history, hidden prompts, credentials or provider sessions.

features.name: Online AI request preparation
features.does: Select up to 20 findings, edit the exact request and choose whether to share it with an AI provider.
features.limit: Embedded online ChatGPT account access remains disabled pending approval.

features.name: Local optional AI
features.does: Use the existing optional account connection and review evidence before each request.
features.limit: Separate setup, network and provider limits apply; sign-in is not proof of inference access.

features.name: Browser-local analysis
features.does: Read your ZIP in device memory without uploading or executing its contents.
features.limit: Hosting sees normal app requests; optional AI sharing is a separate deliberate action. 32 MiB compressed input.

features.name: Local application and CLI
features.does: Analyze locally with Python; release smoke checks verify public file/version consistency without sending user data.
features.limit: File checks are not UI coverage. Local web input limit is 64 MiB; archive bounds still apply.

features.name: Sandbox preparation
features.does: Check host prerequisites and prepare offline VM profiles without launching input code.
features.limit: Preparation is not proof of isolation or application compatibility.

features.name: Experimental sandbox execution
features.does: Run real builds and selected tests in a disposable offline QEMU Linux guest with synthetic settings.
features.limit: Windows pilot only; not general Run ZIP. A developer must review and adapt any other project.

features.name: Disposable service and CMS pilot
features.does: Use guest-local database, login and storage, plus a guarded serial browser preview for the example profile.
features.limit: Image upload passed; reviewer queue was empty, so photo approval/publication remains unverified.

features.name: Exact-package runtime records
features.does: Attach a matching ZIP fingerprint record and keep runtime outcomes separate from static clues.
features.limit: Editable unsigned reviewer evidence; no automatic certification or checklist verification.

journeys.title: Understand a package you received
journeys.goal: Know what was delivered and what to ask next.
journeys.output: Readable HTML report plus questions for the developer.
journeys.limit: A feature explanation is supported code evidence, not proof that the feature works.

journeys.title: Move a project between AI coding tools
journeys.goal: Continue from an evidence-backed handover, for example Claude to Codex.
steps: Export your authorized code package from the original tool
Handover: setup clues, owners, gaps and next checks
Give the next developer the code, reports and selected context
journeys.output: Original code package kept separately, plus one reviewed handover ZIP with reports and optional annotations.
journeys.limit: Manual handover. Reversium does not migrate conversations, agent memory, prompts, secrets or accounts.

journeys.title: Take over maintenance
journeys.goal: Identify first files, required services and unresolved setup tasks.
steps: Handover > Setup clues; Coverage > Setup & readiness
Set checklist owners; optionally include annotations in the handover pack
journeys.output: A scoped investigation and setup checklist for the exact delivery.
journeys.limit: Service references are clues. The developer still verifies versions, permissions, migrations and credentials.

journeys.title: Plan a change without guessing
journeys.goal: Find candidate components to inspect before editing.
steps: Use your editor and normal tests; save a new baseline
journeys.output: Candidate impact notes and a source-backed test plan.
journeys.limit: Graph reachability is not proof that a component will be affected. Reversium does not edit or deploy code.

journeys.title: Check what changed in a new delivery
journeys.goal: Compare a new package with a saved earlier analysis.
steps: Save technical data (JSON) from the earlier analysis
Select earlier JSON; inspect files, findings and map changes
Check evidence; save comparison notes and next tests
journeys.output: Changed relationships and candidate effects, with disclosed omissions.
journeys.limit: Analyzer versions and packaging can change results. A difference is not automatically a defect.

journeys.title: Ask AI a focused question privately
journeys.who: Owner or developer needing an explanation
journeys.goal: Share only selected evidence and check the answer.
steps: AI: select provider, question and up to 20 findings
Online: manual handoff; local: eligible optional connection
Match cited IDs/locations; record unsupported claims
journeys.output: A reviewed request and a human-checked explanation.
journeys.limit: Nothing is shared automatically. Online account-connected chat is disabled; provider terms/limits apply.

journeys.title: Verify behavior in a disposable local environment
journeys.who: Developer with an explicitly reviewed execution profile
journeys.goal: Separate observed behavior from setup assumptions without touching live.
steps: Analyze package; review alerts and compatibility
Local prerequisites, trusted assets and fresh isolation checks
Fixed reviewed profile: real code, disposable data and accounts
Capture passes/blockers, stop guest and review matching evidence
journeys.output: Exact-package test record and separately recorded manual observations.
journeys.limit: Experimental local profile only, not any ZIP or a simulation. No production/live credentials. VM isolation cannot guarantee zero risk.
